```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load Packages
```{r}
pacman::p_load("dplyr", "Seurat", "glue", "stringr")
```

# Load Data
## Load Sensitivity 5 Seurat Object
```{r}
# 1. HTO Data Sensitivity 5
seu_data <- Read10X(data.dir = "../../data/2024-06-05/pipseeker/Daniel_1_D-results/HTO/filtered_matrix/sensitivity_5/")
seu_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = seu_data$`Gene Expression`, project = "Duodenum_2024-06-05", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# 2. Subset Counts to Contain only barcodes in both Gene Expression & HTO
joint_bcs <- intersect(rownames(seu_obj@meta.data), colnames(seu_data$`Cell Hashing`))

seu_obj <- seu_obj[ ,joint_bcs]
seu_data$`Cell Hashing` <- seu_data$`Cell Hashing`[ ,joint_bcs]

# 3. Add HTO Assay
seu_obj[["HTO"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = seu_data$`Cell Hashing`)
```

# Downstream Analysis
## Normalization
### Gene Expression
```{r}
seu_obj <- NormalizeData(seu_obj)

# Find and scale variable features
seu_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_obj, selection.method = "mean.var.plot")
seu_obj <- ScaleData(seu_obj, features = VariableFeatures(seu_obj))
```

### HTO
```{r}
seu_obj <- NormalizeData(seu_obj, assay = "HTO", normalization.method = "CLR")
```

## Demux
```{r}
seu_obj <- HTODemux(seu_obj, assay = "HTO", positive.quantile = 0.99)
```

Singlets vs Doublets vs Negatives Counts
```{r}
table(seu_obj@meta.data$HTO_classification.global)
table(seu_obj@meta.data$HTO_maxID)
```

## QC
Feature Scatter Before Removing Singlets & Doublets
```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=16}
FeatureScatter(seu_obj, feature1 = "hashtag1", feature2 = "hashtag2") %>% print()

if (!dir.exists("../../output/deodenum-analysis/Step-1-Output/")) {dir.create("../../output/deodenum-analysis/Step-1-Output/", recursive = T)}
  
pdf("../../output/deodenum-analysis/Step-1-Output/Duodenum-Hashtags-Pre-Filtering.pdf", height = 10, width = 12)
FeatureScatter(seu_obj, feature1 = "hashtag1", feature2 = "hashtag2") %>% print()
dev.off()
```

### Subset only singlets
```{r}
seu_obj_singlets <- seu_obj %>% subset(HTO_classification.global == "Singlet")
```

```{r}
table(seu_obj_singlets$HTO_classification)
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=16}
FeatureScatter(seu_obj_singlets, feature1 = "hashtag1", feature2 = "hashtag2") %>% print()

pdf("../../output/deodenum-analysis/Step-1-Output/Duodenum-Hashtags-Post-Filtering.pdf", height = 10, width = 12)
FeatureScatter(seu_obj_singlets, feature1 = "hashtag1", feature2 = "hashtag2") %>% print()
dev.off()
```

Hashtags worked!

# Save RDS
```{r}
saveRDS(seu_obj_singlets, "../../output/deodenum-analysis/Step-1-Duodenum_Singlets_seu_obj.RDS")
```
